name: Alseid
traits: Medium Monstrosity. Walk 40 ft. Dexterity +2, Wisdom +1 and darkvision 60 ft.
Alseid Weapon Training gives proficiency with spears and shortbows. Light Hooves gives Stealth proficiency.
Quadruped. Squeeze through trapdoors, manholes and similar openings that a Medium Humanoid could traverse normally. Ladders, stairs and similar routes count as difficult terrain.
Woodfriend. Leave no tracks and automatically know true north while in a forest.
Speak, read and write Common and Elvish.

name: Erina
traits: Small. Walk 25 ft. Dexterity +2, plus Wisdom or Charisma +1. Darkvision 60 ft.
Hardy. Resist poison damage and roll saving throws against poison with advantage.
Spines. At the start of your turn, a creature you are grappling or that is grappling you takes 1d4 piercing damage.
Keen Senses gives Perception proficiency. Digger gives 20 ft. of burrowing speed through earth and sand. Mud, ice and rock block this movement.
Speak Erina and either Common or Sylvan.

name: Piney
traits: Medium Humanoid. Walk 30 ft. Constitution +2, Wisdom +1 and darkvision 60 ft.
Margreve Within. Meet daily food needs through ordinary food or 30 minutes of direct sunlight. Resist poison damage and roll saving throws against poison with advantage.
Margreve Without. Choose a plantlike feature, such as cracked bark skin or creaking wooden joints, or agree on another feature with the GM.
Roots gives Nature and Survival proficiency. Speak, read and write Common and speak unwritten Piney.

name: Ravenfolk
traits: Sublime Ravenfolk. Medium. Walk 30 ft. Dexterity +2 and Charisma +1.
Constant Tune gives advantage on saves against charm and fear. Cosmic Musician gives Performance proficiency and proficiency with one instrument of your choice.

Sublime Chord. As an action, creatures able to hear you within 30 ft. make a DC 13 Charisma save. On failure they treat you as a casual friend and are charmed by you for 10 minutes. A creature has advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. Recharge on a long rest.
Speak, read and write Common, Ravenfolk and Umbral.

name: Trollkin
traits: Medium. Walk 30 ft. Constitution +2. Darkvision 60 ft. Legacy of Fear gives Intimidation proficiency. Speak, read and write Northern Tongue.
Natural Weapons. Unarmed claws deal 1d4 + Strength modifier slashing. Unarmed fangs deal 1d4 + Strength modifier piercing.

Inhuman Vigor. As a bonus action, spend one Hit Die to recover HP just as on a short rest. The maximum spend rises to two dice at level 6, three at level 12 and four at level 18. Recharge on a long rest. After taking acid or fire damage, the trait is unavailable until a short or long rest.
Night Whisper. Wisdom +1. Once per long rest, announce Spirit Whispers before rolling an ability check or saving throw to roll with advantage.
Stonehide. Strength +1. Thick Hide gives a +1 bonus to AC.
